blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur— As thousands visited the gravesites of their departed loved ones on All Saints’ Day, law enforcers tracked down and arrested Caraga region’s eighth most wanted person inside a public cemetery in Tagbina, Surigao del Sur Sunday morning. Joint police operatives apprehended the 45-year-old farmer around 10:05 a.m. at the Tagbina Public Cemetery in Barangay Poblacion, according to the Tagbina Municipal Police Station. Authorities withheld the suspect’s identity, citing restrictions under Republic Act No. 10173, or the Data Privacy Act of 2012. He is a resident of Barangay Maglambing in this town.
